newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Transport debuts at HK$4.50 per shr.
newsitem.headline: GZI Transport debuts at HK$4.50 per shr.

text.p: Shares of GZI Transport Ltd, the infrastructural spinoff of Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd, made their trading debut at HK$4.50 per share, compared with their issue price of HK$3.23.

GZI Transport issued 250 million new shares at HK$3.23 per share, with warrants on the basis of one warrant for every five shares. It said the 31.25 million shares available for public subscription in Hong Kong were 529 times subscribed.

Global coordinator Peregrine Capital Ltd exercised an overallotment option and 37.5 million additional shares were issued -- 22.5 million for international investors and 15 million for the Hong Kong public.
GZI Transport has invested in six toll road projects, with a total length of 224 km. It said proceeds would be used to finance its investment in existing and future toll road projects in China.
